examples: The cookies are yummy.

yo.definition: used as a casual greeting or to call to someone
examples: Yo, listen to this!
Yo, where are you headed?
She answered with a quick yo.

yardstick.definition: something used as a standard for measuring or comparing
examples: Customer satisfaction is a yardstick for quality.
We used time as a yardstick to compare the teams.

year.definition: a period of time equal to 12 months
examples: I started my job last year.
We meet every year at the festival.

yammer.definition: to talk or complain in a noisy annoying way for a long time
examples: He yammered on about the same problem for an hour.
Stop yammering and let me work.

yowl.definition: to cry or howl loudly, often in anger or distress
examples: The cat yowled all night.
He yowled in pain after the fall.
The yowl woke everyone up.
I heard a yowl near the building.

yardarm.definition: a horizontal spar on a sailing ship, used to support the sails
examples: A flag was tied to the yardarm.
They climbed up to the yardarm to check the rope.

yaw.definition: rotation of a vehicle, especially an aircraft, around its vertical axis
examples: The yaw increased after the turbulence.
Engineers measured yaw during the test.

yaw.definition: to rotate around the vertical axis so the nose swings left or right
examples: The plane began to yaw to the right.
The helicopter yawed slightly during landing.
